name: File Folder
description: A shared file drop over one folder of the space ("File Folder/" unless an editor points it elsewhere, or the space opens it on a folder). The owner, or the owner and the space's editors (the owner chooses), add files by clicking 'Add file' or dragging them in, up to 8 MB each and a file count the owner sets; anyone who can open the frame can list and download them, so publishing the frame shares that folder. The files are ordinary files of the space: they show in the space page, sync to members' copies and open in other tools. Which folder, and the sharing settings, belong to each session of the frame.
